text:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a stacked maintenance across an AZ pair (apac-west1-a/b) with a mirror window in us-east1 (b/c) this Saturday 02:00-05:00 UTC. Plan: rolling node drains + control-plane DB migration + kernel patch. Low-latency SLOs may see short spikes. :warning:

ashwin: ETA on when drains start for apac-west1-a? need to schedule KV cache seeding for hot pools.

maria: apac-west1-a first drain starts 02:00, we'll shift traffic and warm caches before moving to apac-west1-b at ~03:15. us-east1 will mirror 02:30 -> 04:30 local window.

olivia: I'll run cache prime for model-serving after each cohort drain. plan: `curl -X POST /internal/prime -d '{"pool":"saturn","seq_len":512}'` and a small synthetic load (5 qps) for 10min.

sam: Priority tenant list? can we avoid draining any reserved Dedicated pools during their billing window? cost ops asked for heads-up.

maria: yes — reserved-dedicated pools are out of scope. Only shared/hosted pools scheduled. I'll publish a list in the doc.

ashwin: capacity ask — can we spin up 8 spare gpus in us-east1 for 2 hours as a buffer? estimate ~ $1.1k. worth it to avoid soft-fallbacks.

olivia: +1 for buffer. otherwise the routing layer will fall back to smaller-model variants which will degrade latency but keep availability.

devops-bot: Scheduled maintenance created: ID mnt-20260328-azpair. Notifying oncall and posting to status page.

maria: ops playbook (short):
```
# apac-west1-a
1. cordon & drain cohort nodes: `tctl drain --cohort apac-west1-a --grace 300`
2. warm KV cache seed (olivia)
3. monitor latency + autopromo backfill
4. uncordon
# repeat for apac-west1-b then mirror in us-east1
```

ashwin: What about the control-plane DB migration? any expected lock times?

maria: migration is online, single table add column with background copier. expected locks <30s on a handful of shards during the final swap. we'll run it in the middle of the apac window when traffic is lower and after we'd seeded caches.

sam: clients that pin model versions — do we have fallback routing tested? need to ensure tenants with pinned versions don't get evicted.

olivia: routing policy will prefer pinned variant in same region; if capacity insufficient we route to cross-region with `latency_threshold=150ms`. tested on staging, fallback chain validated.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: mnt-20260328-azpair will trigger 30m, 10m, and 1m reminders. Pager escalation only if >15% error rate for 5m.

ashwin: I'll own capacity ops and cost tracking. will post an hourly cost delta after window.

maria: thanks — final checklist today 18:00 UTC: publish tenant-impact list, run preflight `kubectl get pods --selector=pool=saturn -o wide`, and confirm spare GPUs allocation. react with :thumbsup: if good.

sam: :thumbsup:

olivia: :thumbsup: will prepare prime script and monitor dashboards.

ashwin: :eyes: will allocate spares and share cost estimate in #finance-alerts.

maria: Ok closing — I'll publish the announcement and runbook in Confluence, pinging affected SRE owners.
